title: Sage prefab record
description: A prefab record (PrefabRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another prefab record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

components.description: Component data by component id: "sprite_renderer": { … }. A bare name is this file's namespace, then sage.

tags.description: Tags the entity gets, by id or bare name.

tags+.description: Tags to add to the inherited or patched list.

tags-.description: Tags to remove from the inherited or patched list.

parts.description: Setups a plugin declared, by id: "character": { "layer": "enemy" }.

persist.description: Whether an entity spawned from this prefab at runtime is saved; false for effects and other things nothing needs back. (bool, default true)

children.description: Prefabs placed inside this one: parented to it and destroyed with it. (List<PrefabChild>)

prefab.description: What to place. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

at.description: Where, in the parent's frame. Unit: m. (Vector3)

yaw.description: Degrees about +Y, relative to the parent. Unit: deg. (float)

name.description: Optional, so ent_list and a wire can name it. (string)

overrides.description: Changes to the child's prefab for this child alone. (PrefabOverrides)

components.description: Component bodies by id, merged field by field into the prefab's. (JsonObject)

parts.description: Part options by part id, merged field by field into the prefab's. (JsonObject)

children+.description: Adds to "children": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

prefab.description: What to place. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

at.description: Where, in the parent's frame. Unit: m. (Vector3)

yaw.description: Degrees about +Y, relative to the parent. Unit: deg. (float)

name.description: Optional, so ent_list and a wire can name it. (string)

overrides.description: Changes to the child's prefab for this child alone. (PrefabOverrides)

components.description: Component bodies by id, merged field by field into the prefab's. (JsonObject)

parts.description: Part options by part id, merged field by field into the prefab's. (JsonObject)

children-.description: Removes these from "children" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

prefab.description: What to place. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

at.description: Where, in the parent's frame. Unit: m. (Vector3)

yaw.description: Degrees about +Y, relative to the parent. Unit: deg. (float)

name.description: Optional, so ent_list and a wire can name it. (string)

overrides.description: Changes to the child's prefab for this child alone. (PrefabOverrides)

components.description: Component bodies by id, merged field by field into the prefab's. (JsonObject)

parts.description: Part options by part id, merged field by field into the prefab's. (JsonObject)

far.description: How a streamed placement of this prefab is drawn from the far ring: a low-detail mesh or a box. (FarLook)

mesh.description: A low-detail model drawn in its place from the far ring; left out, a box of `size`. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

size.description: The box drawn when there is no mesh: width, height and depth, standing on its position. Unit: m. (Vector3)

material.description: Empty = sage:lit_default. Names a material record. (RecordId)
